term: restricted language versus a restricted inventory
resolution: The expressible domain contains all denotations of formulas in a fixed modal language. The atomsOnly inventory contains just p and omits even Box p. A countermodel to propagation for that inventory is not a countermodel for a domain closed under negation and box. LanguagePropagation keeps both closure assumptions and excluded middle explicit. Duplicate labels can agree throughout the modal language while allPredicates distinguishes them; neither collapse nor modal-language agreement silently identifies metaphysical possibilities.
